name: com.desktopdock.unity
description: Turns a Unity standalone player into a borderless, transparent strip docked to an edge of the desktop (bottom, top, left or right), in the style of idle 'desktop companion' games. Click-through for empty areas, always on top, auto-hide, stepping aside for fullscreen apps, optional screen-space reservation (Windows app bar), resizing by drag, scroll wheel or API with a Resized event, drag to another edge, tiling with other docked games side by side, a tray icon, a global hotkey, a ready-made settings panel, start with Windows, low idle cost, and opt-in per-pixel alpha transparency. Windows; macOS is experimental.

samples.description: A self-building demo scene: drop DockDemo on an empty GameObject, build for Windows, and get a docked transparent strip with edge-switch buttons and clickable critters.
